brief: Latest month 2026-07: cotton 23.1% of US textile and apparel import weight (22.4% over 3 months, 24.3% over 12 months; 22.9% a year earlier).
Apparel only: 51.8% cotton by weight over 3 months, 49.8% over 12 months (12-month low/high since 2020-01: 46.4/51.8%).

Apparel check vs USDA ERS raw-fibre cotton share: 2020 46.7% vs ERS 48.4%, 2021 51.1% vs ERS 51.4%, 2023 47.7% vs ERS 49.0%, 2024 49.2% vs ERS 49.4%, 2025 49.9% vs ERS 50.5%; apparel by weight tracks ERS closely, the all-textile weight series does not (it is dominated by man-made technical textiles and estimated weights).
Check vs USDA ERS annual raw-fibre shares 2019-2025: correlation 0.72 (weight basis), level gap -17.5 pts, so read the monthly series for direction, ERS for level.

Lead/lag: 3-month change in cotton's share vs 6-month change in the ICE cotton / China polyester price ratio k months earlier: strongest negative at 7 months (corr -0.09), strongest positive at 1 months (0.04); Brent leads best at 12 months (0.09).
